title: Composed majority split
statement: For a natural number $m$, define the composed majority map on pairs of sign assignments, one on two coordinates and one on $2m+1$ coordinates, by first taking the majority of the latter assignment and then taking the three-input majority of that sign together with the two signs in the first assignment.
